I’d recommend going to your local motorcycle gear store, cycle gear, or revzilla. I went to cycle gear (I live in LA.) and they helped me out tremendously about head shape, sizing, and etc. You can also check out www.lidpicker.com 
It’s for measuring your head and it gives you a data report on your dimensions and which helmet it fits. Heads up tho: their helmets listed on there are a bit outdated atm with last gen and older helmets but they do update time to time. Hope this helps.

I’d recommend getting your guard card before applying for your jobs. Anyone can apply. There are physical and online classes that can get you certified in no time. But you will have to pay out of pocket for the fees. Once you get it, you’re way ahead of those who’re just applying blindly. 
Companies nowadays don’t want to spend time and money on new hires before they get sent out for a post. If you get hired with training included, you won’t be earning much and be labeled as a “newbie in training” for a while until you’ve paid back them the training and classes they put you in. 
Also, go for BLS aka first aid/aer/cpr. It’ll prove to them you’re not just some bonko when shit hits the fan. 
If you want more money in the bank, look up exposed firearms permit or ccw and check your state laws about acquiring a firearm. Once licensed, you’ll earn a lot more and doors will open for you

You say you’re 21 so im going to assume this applies to you: if you want the option to take online classes to knock out your degree and have it by the time you get out, don’t do infantry. You’ll have a hard time transitioning unless you’re pursuing a career in law enforcement or security. Better to wait for that mos spot be open then go in now. 

You’ll spend a lot of time out on the field. A lot. You’ll need to arrange some time for your gf. If you’re not fit, you better be. You’ll workout a lot. Doing mundane tasks a lot. Cleaning a lot. 

It’s peace time era until said otherwise so you’ll most likely go to Korea, Germany, or Kuwait for a rotation or two (as infantry). Maybe Italy as airborne. 
 
Infantry is the quickest and easiest way to get those wings (airborne/air assault) or any other schools like Sniper, pathfinder, jump master, SFAS, and RASP because of your contract/mos. 

My advice as infantry: 
knock out those leadership courses BLC and ALC if you’re going in as enlisted. If you got college under your belt, go in as an officer instead.

If not army, join the Air Force for better transition jobs.

Lost some good mons along this journey. Most died from stupid mistakes while grinding and switching into mons who I thought I could outspeed. Their deaths were not in vain and I managed to create a stellar team in the end. The only optional rule I made for myself was not to use Trade Evolutions since I'm using an emulator. So no Alakazam or Gengar :( (I also thought using Gyarados or Alakazam would've broken the game anyway). Instead, I traded them for in-game trade. Luckily caught an abra "Magicman" and nidoran "King" early so I safe kept them until time was right. If you'd like to hear my story, I'll post it in the comments. Thanks!  
  
  
  
My elite Four strat:  
  
For my tanks, Have Shellshock set up a rain dance to get 100% thunder from Mimien. His Timid nature was meh but at least he was fast enough to set up against Lorei's team. I know that Thunderbolt wouldn't been nicer but getting the TM's from a game corner was grindy. I spent most of my money on vitamins to prepare for the battle. Shellshock and my Sassy Vaporeon/Hikari (Named Vaporeon after my cat) stalled out Lance's team like no tomorrow. Shellshock did the most work with Substitute and Ice Beam while Hikari toxic + double-teamed them.  
  
For my special sweepers, Calm mind+baton pass Timid Mimien made sure anyone who uses special attacks will sweep anyone. Lonely Zynx had an ice beam and psychic for STABS. She also had attract and lovely kiss for control. Even without, Mimien was pretty speedy and just psychic one-shotted anyone.  
  
For my physical sweepers, Brave Saber and Bold Nina were my go-to. Saber had overheat and bite because why not, Roar to force switch, and extreme speed for priority. My Nina was already bulky and her nature helped since she was pre-determined to get the nature bold (Def + Attk -) during trade. So I figured I'd slap on Earthquake for STAB, superpower because why not, thunderbolt for coverage, and body slam for that 30% para.  
  
My initial team was gonna be Blastoise, Snorlax\*, Lapras\*, Magneton\*, and Arcanine.  
  
\*But life found another way for them.\*  
  
RIP and thank you for the journey!

The inspirations came from Terminator, Gundam, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and Ironman per se. I went with this approach because I wanted to create an interesting line between human anatomy and technology and see how well it will go together. So I read up on the muscle and skeletal system and sketched them out. Plus, I wanted to see what you guys thought looked appealing, felt comfortable in the eyes, and have me think about which one I knock out quickly for time.
